_readme: Every setting for the CYD ticker app. Edit, then push it WITHOUT a rebuild:
Read through the shared appcfg.h loader. Any key may be left out -- the
firmware default applies. A value outside its allowed range is REJECTED and
named on the serial log, not silently clamped.
Wi-Fi credentials are not here, deliberately -- this file is plain text on
a filesystem anyone holding the board can dump. See SECURITY.md.
_brightness: This board has an LDR, so brightness tracks the ROOM rather than the clock.
auto         follow the LDR. false pins the backlight at 'max'.
min, max     the range the LDR maps between, 8-255.
ldrDark      raw LDR reading (0-4095) treated as a fully dark room. The
sensor reads near 0 in room light; raise this if the panel
never dims, lower it if it dims too early.
closedScale  percent of the computed level while the market is shut, 10-100.
_timing: pageSeconds  the list scrolls continuously; this is how long one screen
of rows takes to pass, 2-600. 10 is a readable crawl.
The scroll is frozen while a finger is down, so a tap lands on the row
it was aimed at. Swipe right on the list for the SETTINGS page: scroll
speed, backlight, tap sound and auto-return changed there are kept in
NVS and WIN over this file, like the C6's layout choice. The boot log
_sparkline: Yahoo's granularity for the intraday series -- the same request the price
comes from, so the series is free but the payload is not.
15m ~26 points.   30m ~13 points, for long lists on a tight heap.
_sleep: The night window for the SETTINGS page's sleep=night option, hours 0-23,
may wrap midnight. Asleep means DEEP sleep: panel and radio off, the chip
drawing microamps, woken by a touch (for a minute, showing the prices it
went to sleep with) or when the window ends. sleep=closed follows the
market instead: asleep until the next weekday's pre-market.
_alerts: A three-note chime (and two white blinks of the LED) when a price crosses
a line. movePct: any stock moving that far in a day, 0-100, 0 = off; once
per symbol, re-armed when it comes back inside half of it. levels: a line
per symbol, 'above' and/or 'below', once per crossing, re-armed 1% back:
The tap-sound setting silences the chime too; the blink stays.
_detail: The per-stock page, reached by tapping a row.
returnSeconds  auto-return to the list after this long, 0-3600; 0 never.
refreshOnOpen  fetch the tapped symbol next, ahead of the sweep.
_refresh: Minutes between price refreshes. Stocks cost one HTTPS request EACH; coins
all travel in one CoinGecko request. Fetches run on core 0 and stay
strictly sequential: each TLS session is ~40KB of a 320KB heap.
extendedMinutes  in pre-market and after hours, 1-1440. The detail page
While the market is CLOSED (weekends, and nights between the post and
pre sessions) stocks are swept once after the close and then not at all.
_timezone: POSIX TZ string, for the clock AND the market window below.
_market: The trading day as HH:MM in the timezone above, Mon-Fri: pre-market from
'pre', regular 'open'-'close', after hours until 'post', closed otherwise.
Drives the refresh policy, brightness.closedScale and the CLOSED /
PRE-MKT / AFTER HRS tag. pre <= open < close <= post or all four reset.
_symbols: Six rows per page, 32 symbols maximum, labels capped at 5 characters.
stocks  Yahoo symbols.   coins  CoinGecko ids, with a label to show.
